snippet.title: Giant's Path - Save lives and unveil the mysteries of the abandoned city!
snippet.description:
Play for free on itch.io https://togeproductions.itch.io/giants-path?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt A distress call asking for help has been found in Ambasari, an abandoned city where the death battle between two giants, Kalagigas and Metasakti, occured. As a Civil Rescue Team it’s your job to help them.

Brave the path surrounded by dangerous emergences, dodge incoming hazards, save lives, and unveil the mysteries of the abandoned city.

➡️ More from Toge Productions https://togeproductions.itch.io/?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt
